model_assumptions.incoming_loads: Loads arriving at Floor 96 are replayed from the validated V8J cold path through Floors 99, 98 and 97. They remain outputs of the V8I/V8J reduced model, not measured column loads.
model_assumptions.local_topology_rule: Figure 5-59 is used only to accept, reject or mark ambiguous the seven V8J cut-boundary connections. No diagonal nearest-four edge is retained unless an orthogonal path is visible.
model_assumptions.support_rule: A removed Floor 96 column is locally supported only if the figure shows a continuous beam route to at least one surviving core-column node.
model_assumptions.force_displacement_rule: Topology is tested before capacity. A loaded node with no surviving path has zero local transfer capacity regardless of the assumed beam section.
model_assumptions.candidate_505_path: The visible 505-506 and 505-605 paths are screened with the inherited 14WF136 plus cold-upper slab law only as a proxy sensitivity; that section is not claimed as the as-built Floor 96 assignment.

gate_definition.required_condition: Every loaded removed-column node must have a surviving, mechanically specified path with sourced topology, section, connection, stiffness and deformation capacity.
gate_definition.pass_policy: A figure-constrained topology may falsify the local Floor 96 bridge hypothesis, but cannot validate the whole building or contradict observed stability when multistory frame action and global redistribution are omitted.
